body:
The follow-up scored/aligned/library audit is complete: [report and frozen reproduction](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/50a2af40f32cad0f297d71884c9215310f17011d/experiments/2026-10-25_0844_codex_dilution-scoring-lineage/README.md).

Independent pandas/Fraction replay reconciles all 29,039,248 original cells across 12 tables, 76,561 scored candidates, 64,070 aligned slots and 297,876 numerical comparisons. The 11 new assets are 389,468,698 bytes, preserved once under shared data storage.

Concrete source findings for the compiler:

- 49,646 aligned slots have exact feature/run IDs with matching form, charge, precursor and target state; their intensities are exactly equal.
- 10,939 slots have missing feature IDs/scores: 4,932 positive intensities, 5,743 zeros and 264 NA. Another 3,485 IDs are absent from the deposited score exports. Pinned pipeline code applies parameterized q-value export filters; no exported match is not proof of no internal candidate.
- Library TransitionGroupId is a different namespace from scored/aligned precursor numbers. The original numeric-ID hypothesis failed and remains archived. Exact full-form/charge/target-state membership reconciles every form without ambiguity; retain both source IDs and the membership relation.
- Ten aligned group labels are empty versus literal NA in the library for the same form/charge. Preserve both missing literals.
- Nine intended heavy standards each have 84 target transitions and ten aligned slots. Of 90 slots, 87 match scored features; the remaining three have missing IDs/scores (one positive and two zero).
- The tenth intended standard is absent from the master library and both exports, including bare-sequence membership. It must not create ten negative observations.

The shared adapter spec now records the namespace distinction. Source preservation is supported; implementation/tested publication and a separately registered likelihood/selection contract remain pending. Preserve the dose conflict, uncertain study overrides and nominal solution versus injected/certified amount. This is no APC concentration or predictive-performance claim. No native outer partition was accessed. All five stages passed the existing resource limits.

Large audit JSON files are compressed with verified byte-exact restoration; no scientific rows or original results were discarded.
